cards.title: Play School is back – and parents are relieved
cards.body: This beloved children's show offers quality programming parents feel comfortable with for their toddlers. Unlike frantic modern shows designed to grab attention like smartphones, Play School provides a calming alternative.

cards.title: Working parents face school holiday logistical nightmare
cards.body: School holidays create scheduling chaos for working parents juggling childcare and work commitments. Parents wish schools aligned with work calendars to make family time less stressful.

cards.title: Making sure kids know their value matters
cards.body: Harsh parental comments can damage children's self-esteem long-term, even when parents forget saying them. Parents should recognize how careless words stick with kids for years.

cards.title: Parenting styles: gentle, helicopter, or snowplough?
cards.body: Parents feel overwhelmed choosing between different parenting approaches with conflicting advice. Understanding the strengths and limitations of each style helps parents find their own fit.

cards.title: Stepparents can improve relationships by bettering family life
cards.body: When stepchildren notice a stepparent improving family dynamics, their resistance to bonding often decreases. Creating positive change builds trust naturally over time.

cards.title: Adult children and parent health decline: processing emotions
cards.body: Adult children from chaotic or addicted families face extra emotional complexity when a parent becomes seriously ill. Processing these layered feelings requires patience and support.
